Storage

Cloudian

S3-Compatible Object Storage at Scale

Software-defined object storage that scales from terabytes to exabytes on standard hardware, on-premises or in hybrid cloud — with native Amazon S3 API compatibility.

Overview

Cloudian HyperStore is a software-defined object storage platform built on native Amazon S3 API compatibility, giving organizations cloud-like storage economics and scalability without leaving their own data center. HyperStore runs on standard x86 hardware and scales out linearly from a few terabytes to hundreds of petabytes.

Designed for unstructured data — backups, archives, analytics data lakes, and AI/ML training sets — Cloudian provides a single, S3-compatible namespace that spans multiple sites, enabling geo-distributed data protection, hybrid cloud tiering, and simplified application integration.

Platform Components

HyperStore

S3-compatible scale-out object storage.

Unified observability and analytics.

Key Features

Cloud-scale object storage built for the data center.

Native S3 API Compatibility

Broadest S3 API support in the industry for drop-in compatibility.

Linear Scale-Out

Add nodes to grow capacity and performance without downtime.

Multi-Site Replication

Active-active geo-distributed replication for resilience and locality.

Hybrid Cloud Tiering

Automated policy-based tiering to public cloud for cost optimization.

Erasure Coding

High durability with significantly less overhead than replication.

Multi-Tenancy & QoS

Per-tenant quotas, billing, and quality-of-service controls.

Immutability & Object Lock

WORM-compliant object lock for ransomware protection.

HyperIQ Monitoring

Unified observability across the storage environment.

Business Benefits

Cloud Economics On-Premises

S3-compatible object storage on standard hardware delivers cloud-like scalability without unpredictable egress costs.

Investment Protection

Applications built for AWS S3 work against Cloudian without modification, protecting existing development investment.

Ransomware Resilience

Object lock immutability and geo-distributed replication protect backup and archive data from tampering.

Simplified Scaling

Linear, non-disruptive scale-out means capacity planning no longer requires large upfront over-provisioning.
